fields.name: flags
fields._note: Bit-level flags (e.g., byte 7 bit 1 = completeness) are the domain schema author's responsibility. The adapter maps byte values to labels, not individual bits. For bit-level flags: (a) map full byte values, e.g. {"0":"no_flags","2":"partial_schema"}, or (b) split into separate boolean fields in your domain schema.
